summary: Vox Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary completed the sale of a capped 4.5% gold royalty on 46,372 oz of remaining gravity gold production from the Hera Tenement in New South Wales, Australia, for A$8,000,000 cash. The royalty was acquired in February 2026, yielding a ~16x return in under four months. The transaction was direct with the Hera project owner; no advisors or board recommendation mentioned. The press release indicates proceeds will be redeployed. Watch for future asset transactions and any impact on Vox’s per-share returns.
